title: Wedelolactone attenuates myocardial ischemia/reperfusion injury through inhibition of ferroptosis via the METTL3/BRD4 axis.
authors: Zhao, Xiaoxue; Zhang, Bingyu; Duan, Sining; Wu, Tengfei; Yang, Xiaojiao; Liu, Yuxiang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物Wedelolactone通过METTL3/BRD4轴抑制心肌缺血再灌注损伤中的铁死亡，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Growing evidence demonstrated the involvement of ferroptosis in the pathogenesis of myocardial ischemia/reperfusion injury (MIRI). The nature compound Wedelolactone (Wed) exhibits anti-ferroptosis effects. The current study aims to explore the impact of Wed on MIRI and reveal whether Wed could protect cardiomyocytes from ferroptosis. Rats underwent cardiac IR operation, and H9c2 cardiomyocytes were subjected to oxygen-glucose deprivation/reoxygenation (OGD/R). Rats or cell in Wed-treated group were subdivided into 2 different dose regimens: low and high. Wed intervention alleviated myocardial infarction and left ventricle dysfunction, and diminished the levels of biochemical markers for cardiac injury caused by cardiac IR. The content of Fe(2 +) and MDA, 4-HNE expression, and ROS production were increased in infarct zone, as well as GSH content, GSH-Px activity, and the levels of ferroptosis-related proteins were reduced. Treatment with Wed reversed the aforementioned changes. Similar results were observed in vitro experiments. Molecular docking analysis showed good binding affinity between Wed and the target protein METTL3. In OGD/R-induced H9c2 cells, Wed downregulated METTL3 protein expression and further blocked METTL3-mediated m(6)A modification of BRD4 mRNA. Overexpression of METTL3 reversed the antagonistic effect of Wed on cardiomyocyte ferroptosis. Collectively, our findings uncovered that Wed showed anti-ferroptosis effects in cardiomyocytes through downregulating the METTL3/BRD4 axis, thereby ameliorating MIRI.
abstract_zh: 越来越多的证据表明，铁死亡（ferroptosis）参与心肌缺血/再灌注损伤（myocardial ischemia/reperfusion injury, MIRI）的发病机制。天然化合物蟛蜞菊内酯（Wedelolactone, Wed）具有抗铁死亡作用。本研究旨在探讨Wed对MIRI的影响，并揭示Wed是否能保护心肌细胞免受铁死亡。大鼠接受心脏IR手术，H9c2心肌细胞经受氧糖剥夺/复氧（oxygen-glucose deprivation/reoxygenation, OGD/R）处理。Wed处理组的大鼠或细胞被分为两种不同剂量方案：低剂量和高剂量。Wed干预减轻了心肌梗死和左心室功能障碍，并降低了心脏IR引起的心脏损伤生化标志物水平。梗死区中Fe(2+)和MDA含量、4-HNE表达及ROS产生增加，而GSH含量、GSH-Px活性及铁死亡相关蛋白水平降低。Wed处理逆转了上述变化。体外实验观察到类似结果。分子对接分析显示Wed与靶蛋白METTL3之间具有良好的结合亲和力。在OGD/R诱导的H9c2细胞中，Wed下调METTL3蛋白表达，并进一步阻断METTL3介导的BRD4 mRNA的m(6)A修饰。METTL3过表达逆转了Wed对心肌细胞铁死亡的拮抗作用。总之，我们的发现揭示了Wed通过下调METTL3/BRD4轴在心肌细胞中发挥抗铁死亡作用，从而改善MIRI。
